artDirection: books/being-and-time/design/ART-DIRECTION.md (binding incl. §9 reader-contract conformance + §10 v1.1 addendum / ArtDirector PROVISIONAL PASS B1-B8); READER-CONTRACT v1.1 STABLE (A.2 symbol key, A.0 end seals)
cohortBeat: Leveling They → attunement. The regulated stand: trunk count and regularity ARE the argument — one stray trunk (§25), nine working trunks (§26), TWELVE IDENTICAL trunks + narrowed shaft + gridded dot-rows (§27, binding), then the stand dissolves 8→6 as disclosedness (§§28–34) widens the light. gapWidth 30→38% with the 28% binding dip at §27; shaft 26° softening (blur 0→9); ghosts left-bleed shrinking 24→18vw; NO ember.

chosen.evolution: p2c17 one leaning trunk + interrogative shaft → p2c18 nine trunks + tool-shadows + leaping chevrons → p2c19 TWELVE IDENTICAL trunks + narrowed shaft + gridded dot-rows → p2c20 surveyor plan (A/B fork) → p2c21 fog bands → p2c22 fear chevrons → p2c23 project fan → p2c24 fore-rings + as-ticks → p2c25 hammer + pointing rule → p2c26 voice arcs from silence.
chosen.name: D1 'The Regulated Stand' (CHOSEN)
chosen.why: Deepest prose root: trunk-regularity literalizes leveling-down, shaft-floor objects literalize readiness-to-hand, shrinking ghosts literalize the dissolving I. Strongest title-swap guarantee; unifies heterogeneous imagery into one grammar (objects in light); maximally distant from the rejected baseline; prototype-verified at 3 chapters x 3 viewports.

considered.name: D2 'Weather of the There' (rejected)
considered.rejectedWhy: Mood-weather is portable to any atmospheric book (weakest title-swap test); risks reading as filter-effects; the They's structural leveling has no sharp correlative.
considered.salvage: Fog bands become the §29 floor treatment.

considered.name: D3 'Ledger of the Who' (rejected)
considered.rejectedWhy: Pronoun-ghosts fight the §-numeral ghost ledger (two competing giant texts); risks one-note gimmick; weakest SVG authorship.
considered.salvage: German terms become the margin-rail voice.
